response.description: The Applications feature in Azure API Management is now available in public preview to all customers, with no sign-up or registration required.Applications provide a streamlined way to organize APIs around consuming applications and manage application-level access. API providers can register applications, associate them with API products, and use Microsoft Entra ID to enable secure, identity-based API consumption.With Applications, organizations can:Simplify application onboarding: Register and manage API-consuming applications directly in Azure API Management.Enable identity-based access: Use Microsoft Entra ID and OAuth 2.0 client credentials to authenticate applications accessing APIs.Streamline API authorization: Associate applications with products to control access to APIs.Improve developer experience: Provide a centralized experience for managing applications and API access.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure API Management Application
